page_title: PAR 1-3 BOL | Parma v Bologna 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Kevin Bonacina is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bologna was in an offside position.
90+5' Kevin Bonacina blows for a foul after Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+4' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
90+2' 1 - 3 Goal! A great through ball by Nicolo Cambiaghi sets up Juan Miranda (Bologna) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the roof of the net. 1:3.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) latches onto a lofted pass from Nicolo Cambiaghi on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
87' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
86' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

85' Nikola Moro (Bologna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Kevin Bonacina with no other option than to blow for a foul.
84' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Kevin Bonacina blows for a foul.
83' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) looks to pass after collecting a rebound, but a lack of options forces him to shoot from distance and it's easily blocked by an opponent.
82' Juan Miranda (Bologna) makes a strong challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows for a foul.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Riccardo Orsolini walks off the pitch to be replaced by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna).
82' Daniel Niccolini prepares a substitution. Jonathan Rowe is replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).

81' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Lukasz Skorupski was alert and the score remains the same.
79' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Kevin Bonacina had an easy-decision to make.
79' Substitution. Adrian Benedyczak makes his way off the pitch and Patrick Cutrone (Parma) comes on as his replacement.
78' Carlos Cuesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hernani (Parma) replacing Sascha Britschgi.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Milan Djuric (Parma) comes onto the pitch for Mateo Pellegrino.
77' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
76' Kevin Bonacina couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) and blew his whistle.
75' Emil Holm (Bologna) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
74' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
72' Here is a change. Jens Odgaard is going off and Daniel Niccolini gives the last tactical orders to Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
72' It is time for a substitution. Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) is on for Santiago Castro.
72' Rough tackle by Jonathan Rowe (Bologna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Referee Kevin Bonacina points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Bologna players.
69' Celebrations by Bologna are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
68' 1 - 2 Goal! Santiago Castro (Bologna) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
67' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
67' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:4.
63' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna). Kevin Bonacina saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
62' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Santiago Castro (Bologna) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
58' Dangerous play by Emil Holm (Bologna). Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
56' Daniel Niccolini is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Remo Freuler suffers an injury and Nikola Moro (Bologna) comes on.
55' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Adrian Bernabe Garcia and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
55' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the left post, but Zion Suzuki makes a decent save to stop the effort.
53' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle. Sascha Britschgi (Parma) commits a foul after dangerous play.
52' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Santiago Castro (Bologna), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
51' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
51' The ball is out of play and Parma manage to earn a corner. Enrico Del Prato (Parma) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
50' One of the players from Bologna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
43' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) commits a rough foul. Kevin Bonacina stops the game and makes a call.
43' Emil Holm (Bologna) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
40' Alessandro Circati is being substituted because of an injury. Carlos Cuesta sends Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) on the pitch.
38' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Jens Odgaard (Bologna), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
37' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
37' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Bologna.
35' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle and Christian Ordonez (Parma) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.

34' Zion Suzuki pulls off a great save to deny Santiago Castro (Bologna), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
34' The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
34' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Bologna will have a corner.
31' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.

30' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the bottom right corner, but Zion Suzuki pulls off a great save to deny him.

29' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
28' Christian Ordonez (Parma) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
27' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
25' Emil Holm (Bologna) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
24' Nahuel Estevez doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Oliver Sorensen (Parma) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
23' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) commits a rough challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul.
20' The ball rebounds out to Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
20' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

20' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him. The ball is out of play. Bologna win a corner kick.

17' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Santiago Castro (Bologna). Emil Holm plays a fantastic through ball and finds Santiago Castro (Bologna), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 1:1.

16' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) didn't hesitate to shoot from around the penalty spot and aimed towards the top left corner. Lukasz Skorupski was alert, made a superb save and parried the ball onto the post.
14' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
12' A cross is whipped in towards Jens Odgaard (Bologna) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
11' Flag goes up against Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
10' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
9' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
8' Christian Ordonez (Parma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Kevin Bonacina has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
7' Bologna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
7' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bologna are going to take it.
7' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
3' It looks like Remo Freuler (Bologna) saw red with that tackle. Kevin Bonacina won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

1' 1 - 0 Goal! Adrian Benedyczak displays great vision and sends a pass to Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Parma will take the kick-off.
